scope.summary: Designs and builds third-party native controls for wrapped Canvas apps, producing a prebuilt `.ppmplugin` bundle (Android DEX plus flat iOS framework and manifest) together with a matching dispatcher PCF control.

externalNetworkCalls: Gradle and Maven artifact resolution during Android builds
Xcode and Swift/CocoaPods dependency resolution during iOS builds
npm registry for the Power Apps component framework toolchain

dependencies.name: Android build toolchain
dependencies.description: Producing the Android DEX half of a `.ppmplugin` bundle requires a local Android SDK and Gradle installation.

dependencies.name: macOS with Xcode
dependencies.description: Producing the iOS `.framework` half of a `.ppmplugin` bundle requires macOS and Xcode.

dependencies.name: Power Apps Wrap
dependencies.description: The generated control only runs inside a wrapped Canvas app, so Wrap must be available and approved for the tenant.

dependencies.name: Power Apps component framework
dependencies.description: The dispatcher control is a PCF control and requires PCF to be enabled in the target environment.

technologies.name: Kotlin
technologies.usedFor: Android side of the native control.

technologies.name: Objective-C
technologies.usedFor: iOS side of the native control.

technologies.name: Power Apps component framework
technologies.usedFor: Dispatcher control that bridges the Canvas app to the native module.

exceptions: The generated UI is native Android/iOS code rendered inside a wrapped Canvas app. EDS publishes no native mobile component library, so EDS applies only as accessibility and design guidance.

blockers: Internal owner and support channel are not assigned.
Skills and bundled build guidance are not reviewed against Equinor guidance.
Producing a `.ppmplugin` bundle requires local Android and Apple build toolchains that are not covered by an Equinor developer baseline.
Shipping a signed native binary into a wrapped Canvas app has not been assessed against Equinor mobile application management and code-signing requirements.
Technology Radar status is unknown for Kotlin, Objective-C, and the Power Apps component framework in this context.

evidence.summary: Initial review after the plugin arrived in the fork through upstream sync 2026-09-09 (power-apps-mobile-extension v0.1.0). No MCP server, no hooks, and no bundled runtime scripts; the plugin is skill and reference documentation only.
Documents the design and build skills, the `.ppmplugin` bundle format, and the wrap runtime prerequisites.

notes: Initial review record only. Publication is deferred until detailed review evidence exists. The plugin performs no Power Platform writes itself, but the artefact it produces is a native binary loaded into a wrapped Canvas app, which is the part that needs an owner and security assessment.
